# Disabled Save click needs a scoped accessibility exception

For D332899 at revision 61fdeb24a40374feeb64fe1685f402200b2304c5, the edit task reports that an intentional pointer click on disabled Save reaches the non-interactive footer and triggers the accessibility checker. The recorded test change sets mustHaveAccessibleRule to false only around that click, then calls AccessibilityUtils.resetEnv(). It retains the disabled-state, direct Save rejection, and zero-transaction assertions. This is a local test-harness exception, not a reason to give the footer an interactive role or disable checks for other interactions. The AI reports passing commlint, syntax, and whitespace checks, but no runtime tests. No matching Calendar example was found, so the style evidence assessment remained incomplete.

Scope: Calendar edit Save browser test.
